name: meshcentral-inventoryscanner
description: Shows what is installed on every device, which of it is vulnerable (matched offline against the NVD feeds on your server) and what needs updating - with ratings per location, printable reports and CSV exports. Optional and off by default: software and OS updates, deployment, Windows Update repair, restart and PC reset, license keys, and a push to your own asset-management system.

scripts.test: node tools/check.js && node tools/test-plugin.js && node tools/test-views.js

author: derStephan
